info.title: IfcIO - Pure Managed Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) CLI Tool
info.description: Fast, pure managed command-line tool for reading, converting, inspecting, and packaging Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) BIM models.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export model to glTF 2.0 (.glb), Wavefront OBJ (.obj), or re-encode IFC

commands.name: info
commands.description: Inspect IFC model metadata, spatial hierarchy, and geometry statistics

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Compress an .ifc physical file into a standard .ifczip archive

commands.name: unpack
commands.description: Extract the .ifc physical file from an .ifczip archive

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate ISO 10303-21 STEP structure, header, and spatial relationships

options.name: --report
options.description: Display detailed category and storey breakdown in info command
